questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride alongside traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the road ahead has low clearance. Tall vehicles may not fit under overhead structures in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a change in traffic pattern or route due to construction. Follow the marked detour route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging onto your road, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps entering vehicles merge smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means Yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and vehicles on the cross road go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there are multiple lanes available for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to wet pavement ahead. Wet roads are slippery and make vehicles harder to control. Drive carefully and reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road is about to cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roadways separated by a median or rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones ahead. This sign tells you that construction will change the normal driving route. Be prepared to follow a redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left at a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you of work ahead on the highway. Slow down and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that cattle may cross the road ahead. Watch for animals in the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you lanes are shifting ahead. Be aware of lane changes and follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing area ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a curve is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that you must obey. It is often posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter the roadway from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It tells you loose gravel is on the road ahead. Drive with extra caution on gravel because your tires will have less traction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road turns sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead makes an extreme turn to the right. Slow down before you reach this sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign warns you the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
